changes.before: Add a computed label without storing a second copy of the same information.
changes.after: Add a useful property to a type with an extension.

before: An extension adds behavior to an existing type without rewriting its original declaration.
A computed property calculates its value when read. This extension does not store a second label.
Extensions can add methods and computed properties. They cannot add stored instance properties to an existing type.

For the exercise, add an extension to Task with a summary property. Return "Title: done" when done is true, otherwise "Title: pending". Read the current properties so a later change to done changes the next summary.
after: A type describes a kind of value, such as a Box. An extension adds useful features to that type without changing its original definition.
A computed property works out its answer when you read it. Here, description joins Box: with the current label. It does not save another copy of that label.
An extension can add a computed property or a method, which is a function belonging to a type. It cannot add a new stored property to each existing box.
Add a summary property in an extension of Task. Use its current title and done values. If done is true, return the title followed by : done. Otherwise, follow the title with : pending.

before.question: A computed summary uses task.done. You change done from false to true and then read summary again. What happens?
choices: It uses the current done value and shows the new summary
It stays at its first result because all properties are stored
An extension makes Task a reference type
before.explanation: The computed property runs when read and uses current stored values. Adding an extension does not change a struct into a class.

after.question: You change a task's done value, then read its computed summary. What happens?
choices: The summary uses the new done value
The summary always keeps its first answer
The extension turns Task into a class
after.explanation: A computed property works out its answer each time you read it.

project.title: Extend a type with a useful view
project.task: Extend Task with a computed summary property. Return the current title followed by : done or : pending, based on done.
project.done_when: The summary changes when done changes, without storing a second summary.
